title: AISU 50ml Shortfill – Blue Raspberry
description:
Blue Raspberry by Aisu is a flavour that replicates the blue slushie taste. The sweet and sharp Blue Raspberry is felt throughout each vape that is complimented by Icy menthol exhale for a delicate finish.
AISU Blue Raspberry has 70%VG / 30%PG for maximum flavour enhancement and dense clouds and comes in a 60ml bottle with space for a nicotine shot
70% / 30% | VG / PG
